@allure.title("Verify username and sign out functionality")
    @allure.severity(allure.severity_level.CRITICAL)
    def test_sign_out_functionality():
        # Configure Chrome options
        options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
        options.add_argument("--start-maximized")
        options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
        options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
        driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)
    
        try:
            # 1. Login
            with allure.step("1. Perform login"):
                driver.get("https://alv-vicas.livnsense.com/#/auth/login")
                WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Username']"))
                ).send_keys("madan")
                driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Password']").send_keys("Madan@123")
                driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//button[contains(text(), 'Sign In')]").click()
                WebDriverWait(driver, 30).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//img[@alt='Autoliv']"))
                )
    
            # 2. Verify username
            with allure.step("2. Verify username 'Madan' is visible"):
                username = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.profile-img div.user-name"))
                )
                assert username.text.strip() == "Madan"
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="username_verified",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            # 3. Sign out process
            with allure.step("3. Perform sign out"):
                # Click profile dropdown
                dropdown_icon = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.profile-img div.dropdown-icon"))
                )
                driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", dropdown_icon)
                time.sleep(1)  # Wait for dropdown animation
    
                # Wait for sign-out dialog to appear (multiple approaches)
                try:
                    # Approach 1: Wait for dialog text
                    WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                        EC.text_to_be_present_in_element(
                            (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box .main.txt"),
                            "Are you sure you want to sign out?"
                        )
                    )
                except:
                    # Approach 2: If dialog text not found, wait for dialog container
                    WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                        EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box"))
                    )
    
                # Find and click sign-out button (multiple selector attempts)
                sign_out_found = False
                sign_out_selectors = [
                    (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.sign-out-btn"),  # Primary selector
                    (By.XPATH, "//button[contains(., 'Sign Out')]"),  # Fallback by text
                    (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box button")  # Generic fallback
                ]
    
                for selector in sign_out_selectors:
                    try:
                        sign_out_btn = WebDriverWait(driver, 5).until(
                            EC.element_to_be_clickable(selector)
                        )
                        sign_out_btn.click()
                        sign_out_found = True
                        break
                    except:
                        continue
    
                if not sign_out_found:
                    raise AssertionError("Could not find sign out button with any selector")
    
                # Verify logout
                WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.url_contains("auth/login")
                )
    
        except Exception as e:
            allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                          name="signout_failure",
                          attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
